newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Steel sees flat-rolled products demand strong.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Steel sees flat-rolled products demand strong.

text.p: USX-U.S. Steel Group should experience strong demand for its flat-rolled products in the first quarter of 1997, USX Chairman Tom Usher said in the company's fourth quarter earnings release.
"Demand for flat-rolled products is expected to remain strong through the first quarter of 1997, although steel shipments normally face a seasonal decline from fourth quarter levels," Usher said.
Usher also said markets for tubular goods continue to show improvement.

U.S. Steel, the nation's largest steelmaker, posted fourth quarter earnings Thursday of $1.41 per share, exceeding Wall Street's consensus estimate of $1.22 per share. Fourth quarter earnings in '95 totaled $0.82 per share.
Usher said the '96 results reflect efficient operating performance coupled with a strong order book.
